title: Initial Template Scaffold
message: First release of the Catherine full-stack template — a production-grade Express v5 + React 19 foundation with clean layered architecture and a standardized API contract.

whatChanged.text: Established the full-stack project structure
items: React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 frontend with the Aumovio Design System
Node.js + Express v5 backend with a class-based OOP architecture

whatChanged.text: Defined the frontend three-layer architecture (api → hook → view)

Added a standardized API response shape (sendSuccess / sendError)

message: Comprehensive security hardening pass addressing 15 findings from a full-stack audit. The server now refuses to start with placeholder secrets, JWT forgery vectors are closed, and the live security demo no longer blocks real visitors.

whatChanged.text: Added fail-fast boot guard — server exits immediately in production when secrets are still set to template placeholders (C1)

Cookies now force Secure flag in production even when USE_HTTPS=false, supporting TLS-terminating proxy deployments (H2)
Login and admin fields reject object-typed values, blocking Mongo-style operator injection like {"$regex":".*"} (H3)
Live security demo returns simulated responses in production builds, preventing visitors from self-blocking their IP (H4)
Response body capture skips SSE streams and caps at 64 KiB to prevent memory exhaustion on long-lived connections (M2)
Removed duplicate unprotected /dashboard route that shadowed the role-guarded one (M3)
Pinned HS256 algorithm on all JWT sign/verify calls (L1)
SecurityFilterMiddleware now double-decodes URLs to catch %25-encoded bypass attempts (L2)
Public /health endpoint no longer exposes hostname, PID, or environment (L3)
PII fields (email, name, phone, DOB) added to request log redaction list (L4)

title: Exact-Decimal Money Support
message: Adds multi-currency money handling that never rounds. Amounts are exact from entry through storage to export, and the two operations that cannot be exact — division and splitting — now hand back the remainder instead of quietly losing it.

whatChanged.text: Money is held exactly, never as a decimal approximation

An amount carrying more precision than can be stored is rejected, never silently rounded to fit

whatChanged.text: Splitting an amount always adds back up to the original
items: Dividing 100 three ways distributes the last unit rather than losing it
The same split run twice gives the same answer, so a re-run of a report matches to the last unit

whatChanged.text: Division states its precision up front and returns the remainder
Fixed rounding that was happening inside the database driver
items: Exact values were being converted to approximations before any of our code saw them
The rule is derived from the column definition, so a new money column is protected automatically

whatChanged.text: Multi-currency support with conversion at display and export time
items: Currency codes are stored, never symbols, so no character can be corrupted by a database charset

whatChanged.text: Repeat-safe money operations — a retried request cannot post twice

message: 1,187 backend tests and 30 frontend tests pass. The frontend had no test suite at all before this; the money rules are now enforced by tests rather than by convention.

items: Money splitting proven to balance across randomised inputs and to be order-independent
Rejection cases covered: excess precision refused rather than rounded, oversized amounts survive a full save-and-reload
Database driver proven to hand back exact money while leaving counts and identifiers alone

whatChanged.text: Frontend — test harness stood up from nothing, 30 tests passing
Fixed a flaw in the status-code checker itself
items: Any error message containing a comma was misread, which would have hidden real problems

whatChanged.text: Documented the money rules, storage formats and accounting constraints
Added security-advisory ledgers and deployment runbooks

title: Help Center, Documentation and Test Coverage
message: Adds a searchable Help Center with a floating assistant available on every page, backed by the template's first full documentation set and a frontend test suite that grew from 30 to 554 tests.

whatChanged.text: Added a Help Center at /about/help with category browsing and search
items: Floating assistant on every page, including sign-in
Deterministic lookup over a static corpus — no model, no network call
Hidden for automation roles and on the Help Center page itself

whatChanged.text: Documented the template end to end — 13 technical guides with diagrams
items: Authentication, error handling, data layer, money and caching
Logging, metrics, changelog, admin management, boot and build

whatChanged.text: Grew frontend test coverage from 1 file to 32 across six categories
items: Added integration, security, performance, reliability and chaos suites
Locked the frontend/backend status-code contract with a parity test
554 frontend tests and 1,187 backend tests passing

whatChanged.text: Fixed overlapping page furniture on the landing and dashboard screens
Corrected developer documentation that disagreed with the code
items: Access-control roles are strings; the numeric form denied everyone
The documented middleware chain was missing the CSRF protection step

whatChanged.text: Hardened the demo-account seeder against signature drift
